name: Kurzen's Mystery
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Brother Nimetz seeks the reason for Colonel Kurzen’s fall. He suspects troll magic and sends you to copy legends from four tablets in Stranglethorn’s troll ruins.

sections.title: Searching for Answers
sections.body: Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp seeks the cause of Colonel Kurzen’s fall from greatness into depravity. He suspects troll magic has taken hold of the colonel. Legends carved on four old tablets may test that suspicion. You are asked to copy each tablet’s markings and carry them back to camp.

sections.title: Where the Tablets Lie
sections.body: One tablet stands in the Bal'lal Ruins. Another lies deep underwater in the Vile Reef, off the coast near a sunken city held by Saltscale murlocs. The last two tablets are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

faq.q: Who starts the search for the troll tablets?
aliases: where do i start kurzens mystery
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz begins the search at the Rebel Camp.

faq.q: Why does Brother Nimetz want copies of troll legends?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz seeks to learn why Colonel Kurzen, once a great and noble man, sank into depravity. He suspects troll magic, and the tablet legends may confirm it.

faq.q: Where are the four troll tablets located?
faq.answer: One tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins. Another lies deep underwater in the Vile Reef, west of Grom'gol. The remaining two are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

faq.q: What comes after the four tablets are brought back?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz studies the legends for a link between the trolls and Colonel Kurzen’s fall. The tale continues with Troll Witchery.
